slides.texte_overlay:
5 habits of girls who are
effortlessly easy to talk to

1. they let you finish

no interrupting.
2. they laugh with their whole face

3. they give deeper compliments

not "nice top" but
"you explained that so well".

4. they feed their mind

interesting people like interesting
things. swap mindless scrolling
for learning.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. they feed their mind

they swap mindless scrolling for
lessons on an app like Sophia.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. they text first

no keeping score.

send this to the friend
who does all five
